name: io.github.api-freaks/apifreaks-mcp
title: APIFreaks MCP
description: The official MCP server for APIFreaks, connecting your AI to the full range of APIFreaks APIs.

environmentVariables.name: APIFREAKS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your APIFreaks API key — get one free at apifreaks.com

environmentVariables.name: APIFREAKS_MODULES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated modules to expose as tools (e.g. weather,whois,dns). If unset, only list_modules is advertised. Available: weather, currency, ip-intelligence, whois, dns, domain, ssl, commodity, zipcode, timezone, screenshot, scraper, user-agent, astronomy, financial, email-validation, phone-validation, geocoding, geodb
